## Manuscripts in development

### Surface-elevation change in Vilcanota

The most mature product integrates ICESat‑2 ATL06‑SR, COP30, co-registration, hypsometric correction, robust trends and elevation support.

**Core result:** −1.463 m yr⁻¹; 95% CI: −2.357 to −0.596 m yr⁻¹.

### InSAR dynamics and multi-sensor validation

This manuscript will focus on dE/dU under dN=0, cumulative displacement, quality, noise floor and complementarity with ICESat‑2. It will not be presented as complete 3-D velocity or mass balance.

### Aerosols, black carbon and energy response

This product depends on closing Sentinel‑5P, AE33/AL30, SP2/ions and albedo. The inference unit will be an event with exposure, transport, deposition and lagged response.
